name: Nomi Sonoko
source:
A prim and proper lady as delicate as a flower. Huge tits. 
The daughter of a well-to-do family. Despite a strict upbringing and a complete lack of flaws, she doesn’t put on airs. 
She doesn’t judge anyone and can always be seen with a slight smile set upon her face. 
However, she can be a tad frank and will sometimes hone in on a person’s insecurities without even realizing it. 
Because of this, others find her hard to approach, and she has become a bit distant.
